text: パソコンに　あずけている　どうぐを　すてます

structure.jp: パソコンに　あずけている
structure.en: that you have stored in the PC

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あずけている　どうぐ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing tells you which thing is meant. パソコンに　あずけている　どうぐ = 'the items you have stored in the PC'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb can show a state that still holds after the action was done. あずけている = 'have left in storage'.
